prior_attempt: Output moderation rejected the benign bandaged cartoon foot as self-harm. Retrying with explicit children's picture-book and cloth-wrapping context.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a colour-underpainting layer for a gentle, whimsical children's picture book.
Edit the supplied reference, using every existing line and its exact coordinates as a registration guide. It is an innocuous cartoon drawing of one foot and a lower leg with a cloth bandage wrapping around it. Preserve the complete simple rounded foot, toe, heel, long leaning ankle and original spiral fabric shape, including BOTH faint continuation lines at the top. Do not crop, resize, move, restyle or complete any other anatomy. Keep the original odd, friendly pen-drawing proportions and every irregularity.
Add ONLY very thin translucent watercolour: a pale warm peach/ochre wash in the original foot and ankle areas, nearly white ivory/slate wash in the existing cloth strips, and a tiny soft pigment shadow immediately below the existing sole. Restrained hand-painted watercolor texture, subtle paper pigment pooling, no glossy or plastic finish.
This is ONLY an underpainting. The final book overlays the exact unaltered original black pen master, so omit black outlines from your output; no replacement lines, no new details, no extra objects, no text.
Match the reference canvas aspect ratio, margins, framing and all relative positions exactly. Both faint top continuation lines must be accommodated by the coloured shape with spacious transparent margins. Return genuine transparency outside the existing shape and its small soft shadow: no white/cream paper rectangle or backdrop. Ignore the small graphite speck outside the bottom-left heel, which is photographic text residue.
inspection_note: Foot/bandage composition retained and genuinely transparent; initial successful draft interprets top two upright edge strokes as separate narrow painted strips. Needs upper gap fill before use so they read as edges of one continuous leg.
